name: Wildlands Adventure Zoo Emmen
source: Starting points from the animal markers in OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL) and the Wildlands article on Dutch Wikipedia, November 2026. Not yet checked on site: re-record each spot with ?record=1 on the day.

locations.note: Main entrance under the Atlas Theater; it is also the exit.
Rothschild giraffes, Grant's zebras and white rhinos share the savanna, seen from the path on its west side and from the Serenga Safari truck.
Bactrian camels in the desert next to Animazia.
Indoors: big sea aquarium at the entrance, small aquariums with clownfish, African spurred tortoises at the exit (large, but not a true giant tortoise).
Goats, dwarf donkeys, chickens, Kunekune pigs, rabbits and fancy pigeons. Right next to the sea lions.
California sea lions, harbour town of Nortica.
Snowy owl aviary by the sawmill.
Humboldt penguins, above and under water.
North Sea aquarium (catsharks, smooth-hound) at the research station. Position is a guess: check it.
Asian elephants; also seen from inside Rimbula.
Ring-tailed lemurs inside the Rimbula greenhouse.
Tropical greenhouse at the start of Jungola: butterflies, reticulated pythons and dwarf crocodiles.
Koi in the pond around the monkey ruin by the Mondiala square.
